name: product
title: Products & objects — packaging, devices, single items
finish: medium-format digital capture, fine natural grain, gentle roll-off into the speculars, no digital sharpening
spherical macro prime, honest geometry, slight halation where a specular burns, focus stacked so the whole object holds
modern cinema camera with wide latitude, texture held in the darkest surface and inside the brightest highlight
high-resolution capture with true edge-to-edge sharpness, no vignette, no corner softness, every moulding line clean
a touch of anamorphic character — a subtle horizontal flare across bright speculars, otherwise clean and undistorted
tripod at base ISO, absolute clarity, surface grain, print texture and micro-scratches all legible
documentary stills camera, natural contrast curve, colour matched to the real sample, nothing pushed
no_text: Render every label, carton panel, cap, dial face, screen, badge and moulded surface as a CLEAN BLANK SURFACE. Absolutely no text, no letters, no Korean hangul, no numbers, no logos, no wordmarks, no barcodes and no icons anywhere in the image. Keep the shape, size, colour, finish and position of the label and panel areas, but leave them empty.
negative: text, lettering, letters, words, typography, Korean hangul, numbers, signage text, logo, wordmark, brand name, captions, subtitles, watermark, garbled writing, barcode, icons, dial markings, 3D render, CGI, clay shader, product cut-out pasted onto a flat backdrop, floating object with no contact shadow, missing or doubled reflection, warped ellipse on a cap or rim, melted moulding seam, invented buttons and extra parts, wrong scale beside the hand, waxy doll skin on hands, sticker-flat label, blown-out empty white void, dull washed-out colour, oversharpened halo, sensor dust and stray hairs
ignore: the reference's backdrop colour and studio sweep
the reference's lighting setup and shadow direction
all text, labels, barcodes and logos in the reference
packing dust, lint and stray hairs left on the sample

materials.treatment: real surface evidence — moulding seams and gate marks, brushed grain running one way, anodised sheen, cardboard fibre and print dot, the faint orange peel of a sprayed finish, micro-scratches on glass and metal
materials.condition: a real manufactured sample, handled and in service, not a render

focus: the object held sharp wherever the frame calls for it, focus stacked rather than faked; any falloff comes from the real lens, never from a cut-out mask or an applied blur

still.B: the product alone and immaculate on the sweep, nothing entering the frame, nothing in motion
still.D: nothing moves; the object stands alone and the shadow does all the work

calm: the product standing alone and untouched, its cap set down beside it
the box open with the inner tray half withdrawn, nothing else in frame
one unit at rest with a single bead of condensation held on the glass
the lid resting slightly off true, everything else exact
busy: hands entering frame to open it, the wrapper still coming away
the product mid-pour, its contents running out of it
identical units stacked behind the hero with one being lifted clear
the unit turning on its base as a second one arrives into frame

calm: the full range set out in a row, nothing being touched
one unit pulled forward out of the line, the rest square behind it
the set laid out complete with a single lid left off
identical units in ranks with one gap where one has been taken
busy: hands reaching in to take one unit out of the line
the row being rebuilt, units arriving from off frame
several units in motion at once while the rest hold formation
two of the range held up side by side and compared

calm: the mechanism at rest, the seam closed
one drop held on the surface, not yet running
the button half depressed and holding there
the thread engaged a single turn, nothing moving
busy: fingers working the catch open, the parts separating
liquid running across the surface as it is poured
the hinge swinging through, its edge just beginning to blur
grains still falling past the surface after the pour

calm: the product sitting where it is used, its owner just out of frame
a coat over the chair and the product left on the counter
the device on the bench among the tools it belongs with, switched off
the bag packed and standing by the door, unattended
busy: someone using the product, their hands and forearms in frame
the product carried through the room with people passing behind
the device working on a busy bench as someone reaches past it
the object handed across frame from one person to another

modes.name: tabletop hero
modes.direction: The straight commercial hero frame a tabletop photographer builds on a sweep. Describe the object honestly and legibly rather than dramatise it.
modes.licence: tidy and dress only: clear packing dust, straighten what should sit straight, place this same product's own cap, tray or a second identical unit behind it; never a different kind of object
modes.light: one large soft source high and behind the product with a white bounce filling the near face, a long soft gradient falling down the background, one controlled specular per surface

cam.hero: camera on a studio stand just above the product's shoulder line, three-quarter turn, base held clear of the bottom edge, 85mm feel
cam.group: camera on a stand slightly above the row, three-quarter across the line so each unit steps behind the last, 100mm feel
cam.det: camera on a rail at the height of the feature, three-quarter and close, the rest of the body falling away soft, 100mm feel
cam.situ: camera at the height of the surface the product sits on, three-quarter from a natural standing distance, the room soft behind, 50mm feel

looks: studio daylight balance through heavy diffusion, a still room
natural colour with restrained saturation, clean neutral whites, a warm object against a cool grey sweep
late-morning window light through a diffusion frame, air still
warm soft highlights rolling off gently, shadows open and slightly cool, nothing pushed
overcast daylight bounced off a white wall, no direct sun anywhere
cool desaturated base with a single warm accent, soft filmic contrast, blacks lifted a touch
compo: the product off-centre on a third, the background gradient falling away toward the opposite corner
clear near, middle and far separated by light rather than by blur, the base grounded by its own contact shadow
generous headroom above the product, the surface line low in frame

modes.name: square packshot
modes.direction: The clean elevation the client puts on the page. Nothing is interpreted — the object sits square to the sensor, level, evenly lit and completely legible.
modes.licence: tidy the frame only: clear clutter, level everything, keep the ground a plain sweep; nothing is added and the subject is never swapped for a different kind of object
modes.light: even shadowless commercial light, large sources both sides and above, no muddy shadow, one restrained specular edge holding the form

cam.hero: camera on a rail dead square-on at the exact mid-height of the product, front face parallel to the sensor, even margins on all four sides, 100mm feel
cam.group: camera square-on at the mid-height of the row, every unit parallel to the sensor and evenly spaced, 135mm feel
cam.det: camera square-on to the feature plane, the panel centred and level, 100mm feel
cam.situ: camera square-on at the height of the surface, the product centred in a tidied real setting with even margins, 50mm feel

looks: studio strobe on a white sweep, bright and shadowless
clean neutral white balance, crisp but never clinical, controlled speculars, no colour cast
even fill on a mid-grey background, no direct source
cool-neutral base, precise contrast, whites truly white, restrained saturation
warm-neutral studio light on a pale sand ground, still air
warm neutral with a gentle golden lift in the highlights, immaculate blacks
compo: central symmetry, the object dead centre, equal margins left and right
the product centred with generous space above, the surface line on the lower third
strict horizontal banding — ground, product, contact shadow — in clean stacked zones

modes.name: overhead flat-lay
modes.direction: Treat the object as pure geometry seen from directly above. Shape, edge and colour carry the frame and the surface becomes a flat graphic field.
modes.licence: EXPAND: lay out more of the same product with its own caps, trays, parts and packaging to fill the pattern; never a different kind of object
modes.light: even overhead light with one soft direction, shadow used as a graphic element rather than to model form

cam.hero: camera on an overhead boom directly above the product, sensor parallel to the table, the object centred and reading as a flat silhouette, 50mm feel
cam.group: boom directly overhead at greater height, the whole layout reading as a grid across the surface, 35mm feel
cam.det: boom straight down a hand's width above the feature, flat graphic top-down, 100mm feel
cam.situ: boom directly above the working surface, the product, the hands and the tools around it read as one flat pattern, 24mm feel

looks: a broad overhead soft box, short shadows to one side, no ambient
saturated flat colour, graphic contrast, clean whites
bright overcast through a skylight, all but shadowless
even desaturated base with strong accent colours reading as solid blocks
a single directional overhead source, shadows laid out as part of the pattern
warm light and cool shadow alternating in strict rhythm
compo: an all-over flat pattern with no horizon, the frame read as a single plane
one strong axis — an edge, a fold, a row of parts — dividing the layout in two
a grid of repeating units with one break in the rhythm as the focal point

modes.name: hard single source
modes.direction: One hard light and nothing else. The shadow is the graphic — the object is described by a single sharp edge of light and the black it throws across the ground.
modes.licence: the ground plane and background colour may be changed and the cast shadow lengthened or shaped; the object itself stays exactly as it is and is never swapped for a different kind of object
modes.light: a single bare hard source, undiffused, throwing one sharp-edged shadow, no fill at all, deep black shadow and one hot specular

cam.hero: camera on a boom above the product looking down at about forty-five degrees, the shadow running away from the base into the far corner, 65mm feel
cam.group: camera high on a boom at forty-five degrees across the row, each unit throwing an identical shadow in step, 85mm feel
cam.det: camera close and raking along the surface, the light skimming it so every ridge throws its own shadow, 135mm feel
cam.situ: camera at forty-five degrees above a real surface with direct sun cutting across it, the product's shadow drawn hard on the floor, 35mm feel

looks: hard direct sun through a window at midday, dust hanging in the beam
high contrast, near-black shadow, saturation only where the light lands
a single bare studio head, no fill, coloured paper ground
one hot key against a deep coloured field, crushed blacks, punchy saturation
late afternoon sun raking almost horizontally across the surface
warm key with a long cool shadow, extreme falloff, restrained mid-tones
compo: the object weighted to one side with its hard shadow occupying the opposite half
a bright pool of light in a dark surround, the eye pulled straight to the object
the shadow drawn as one long diagonal from the base to the corner of the frame

modes.name: extreme macro
modes.direction: Go closer than the eye ever does. One feature fills the frame — a seam, a thread, a weave, a knurl — and the material itself becomes the subject.
modes.licence: nothing may be added: only the surfaces already on this object, seen closer; never a different kind of object
modes.light: a small hard source raking across the surface at a shallow angle with a black card opposite, texture picked out in relief, everything beyond the feature falling to nothing

cam.hero: macro on a focus rail, lens a few centimetres from the product, one corner of it filling the whole frame, 100mm feel
cam.group: macro along the line of units so the nearest fills the frame and the rest fall away as a soft repeating stack, 200mm feel
cam.det: macro at minimum distance, the feature magnified past life size, the rest of the object gone from frame, 200mm feel
cam.situ: macro low over the working surface, the product's edge and the fingertip touching it filling the frame, 100mm feel

looks: one small source skimming the surface, everything around it dark
deep contrast, colour concentrated in the lit sliver, blacks near empty
a narrow shaft of window sun crossing the material, the room dark behind
warm raking key against cool shadow, restrained saturation, texture carrying the frame
a hard point source close in with a black card opposite, dust visible in the air
near-monochrome with one saturated accent where the light catches
compo: the feature running corner to corner as a diagonal, everything else falling to black
the frame filled edge to edge by a single surface, no context and no horizon
a sharp band of focus across the middle with the material dissolving above and below it

modes.name: low wide hero
modes.direction: Shoot the object from below as if it were architecture. The camera sits on the deck centimetres from the base, the near edge looms and the product towers into the top of frame.
modes.licence: EXPAND: multiply the same product into ranks behind the hero, lift or suspend it, add motion of that same object; never a different kind of object
modes.light: strong low key with a hard rim separating the object from a dark ground, dramatic falloff, one bright source behind and above

cam.hero: camera flat on the deck a few centimetres from the base looking steeply up, the product filling the frame and running out of the top edge, 20mm feel
cam.group: camera on the deck at the head of the row, the near unit monumental with identical units receding behind it, 18mm feel
cam.det: camera on the surface almost touching the feature, looking up along it so the edge reads monumental against a dark field, 24mm feel
cam.situ: camera set on the real floor or bench surface looking steeply up past the product, the room converging above it, 18mm feel

looks: a hard low key with haze in the air catching the beam
high-contrast warm key against cool shadow, rich saturated highlights, blacks crushed just short of empty
one break of hard light landing on the object against a dark heavy ground
dramatic cool field against a hot lit subject, very wide dynamic range
deep blue ambient with a single hard source burning behind the product
cool blue field punctuated by one intense warm source, cinematic falloff
compo: converging verticals rising out of the top of frame, the base anchored low and close
the hero filling two-thirds of frame with identical units receding behind it
an aggressive diagonal with heavy foreground weight and a deep dark background

modes.name: in hand, in use
modes.direction: Put the object in a working hand in a real room. The frame is about the act of using it — grip, scale, the way a body meets the object — not about the thing standing still.
modes.licence: PEOPLE AND MOTION may be added — hands, forearms, someone using or carrying it, the real room around them — but only ever this same product and never a different kind of object as the subject
modes.light: the room's own available light doing the work, a window on one side or the fixtures overhead, mixed colour temperature left uncorrected

cam.hero: handheld from just over the user's shoulder at their eye-line, the product held out in front of them, the room falling away behind, 35mm feel
cam.group: handheld at chest height as the units are carried and set down, several in frame at different distances, 28mm feel
cam.det: handheld close over the hands at working distance, the fingers and the feature they are working filling the frame, 50mm feel
cam.situ: handheld at standing eye-level a step back from the person, the product in use and the whole room reading around them, 28mm feel

looks: mid-afternoon in a real room, window light from one side, nothing staged
warm skin against a cool ambient, honest mixed white balance left uncorrected
early morning, cold light through the window with the lamps still burning
a cool daylight wedge cutting into a warm interior, natural colour
evening indoors, the room lit only by its own fixtures
amber practicals against deep neutral shadow, restrained saturation
compo: a forearm or shoulder holding the near third, the room opening out past it
the frame very slightly off level, the object caught off-centre as if glanced at
hands and product close and sharp with the depth of the room running away behind

modes.name: where it lives
modes.direction: Photograph the object where it actually sits when nobody is using it — the counter, the bench, the passenger seat, the shelf. The room is half the picture and it explains what the thing is for.
modes.licence: the real setting may be dressed with what already belongs in that room — the surface, the wall, the light through the window — along with more of the same product; the subject itself is never swapped for a different kind of object
modes.light: one window as the only source, soft and directional, the far side of the room falling into natural shadow

cam.hero: tripod at the height of the surface the product rests on, a step back so the wall and the surface read around it, 50mm feel
cam.group: tripod slightly above the surface looking along the row where the units are kept, the room soft behind, 50mm feel
cam.det: tripod close at surface height, the feature sharp and the room reduced to a soft field behind it, 135mm feel
cam.situ: tripod at standing eye-level from the doorway, the product small and correctly scaled in the middle of a real room, 35mm feel
